Center-upper area: add text box with 'Introduction to' on line 1 and 'Machine Learning' on line 2, large bold red (#C00000) sans-serif, centered. 4. Directly below: 'CSAI 253  -  Spring 2024' in bold blue (#0000CC), centered. 5. Below that, centered block: 'Prepared By' (black italic), 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' (black italic, slightly larger), 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' (blue, smaller). 6. Bottom-left, left-aligned block: 'Instructors:' in red bold italic; then 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' in blue bold italic with 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' in smaller blue beneath; then 'Dr. Mohamed Maher Ata' in blue bold italic with 'momaher@zewailcity.edu.eg' in smaller blue beneath. 7. Bottom-right: insert Zewail City logo — teal square with white mountain graphic and 'ZEWAIL CITY' text, beside Arabic 'جامعة العلوم والتكنولوجيا' over English 'University of Science and Technology' in dark red.
